During [[Operation: Insignificant]], members of the [[Brak Sector Force]] staged an impromptu '''battle''' over [[Lish V]] in an attempt to rescue [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] prisoners. However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] planted the information about the prisoner transfer, and instead ambushed the Alliance force with forty [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="FBS" />
